note: Only Kasware and Kastle inject a Kaspa L1 provider into the page. Ledger signs in KasVault or through Kastle. Mobile and hardware stay in their apps.

wallets.name: Kasware
wallets.note: window.kasware.requestAccounts(). KRC-20, KNS, NFTs, legacy 12-word. Documented dApp API. Not on iOS.

wallets.name: Kastle
wallets.note: window.kastle.connect() then getAccount(). KRC-20, NFTs, KNS, Ledger link. On phones, use the Kastle in-app browser.

wallets.name: Tangem
wallets.note: NFC card, EAL6+ secure element, seedless multi-card backup. Kaspa since Apr 2023. Keys stay on the card — a site cannot inject it.

wallets.name: Ledger
wallets.note: Install the Kaspa app in Ledger Live, then sign in KasVault (Chrome/Edge USB). Kastle can also link a Ledger. Ledger Live itself does not host KAS accounts.

wallets.name: OneKey
wallets.note: Open-source hardware + app with native KAS. No documented Kaspa L1 inject on a dApp origin — use the OneKey app/device.

wallets.name: ELLIPAL
wallets.note: QR air-gap. Companion app signs; the dApp never sees the key.

wallets.name: SafePal X1
wallets.note: Native KAS on X1. Pair in the SafePal app, not in the page.

wallets.name: Kaspium
wallets.note: Community-standard open-source mobile wallet. 12/24-word including legacy KDX/web seeds. No browser inject. Pay with a kaspa: URI or QR.

wallets.name: Kaspa NG
wallets.note: Successor of KDX and the legacy web wallet (wiki). Open kaspa-ng.org — it is its own wallet UI, not an inject on your origin.

wallets.name: Kaspa Web Wallet
wallets.note: Legacy 12-word browser wallet. Keys in local storage. Wiki: consider Kaspa NG. Still listed because it holds live funds.

wallets.name: KDX
wallets.note: Desktop GUI + node. Wiki: consider switching to Kaspa NG. 12-word legacy path.

wallets.name: KasKeeper
wallets.note: KEF-backed Kaspa wallet (Tech Trends). KAS + KRC-20. No public inject API used here — install the app/extension.
wallets.source: Chrome Web Store; App Store KasKeeper

wallets.name: Kurncy
wallets.note: Mobile self-custody. KAS, KRC-20, KRC-721, KNS. No browser inject on a dApp origin.

wallets.name: Zelcore
wallets.note: Multi-asset. Native KAS since 31 Mar 2023. Use the Zelcore app.

wallets.name: OKX Web3 Wallet
wallets.note: Non-custodial multi-chain. Holds KAS in the OKX wallet — its inject is EVM, not a Kaspa L1 provider.

wallets.name: NOW Wallet
wallets.note: Non-custodial multi-coin with built-in swap. KAS storage in the NOW app.

wallets.name: Guarda
wallets.note: Multi-currency storage/exchange. Kaspa since 12 Nov 2024.

wallets.name: Bitget Wallet
wallets.note: Multi-chain hot wallet with KAS storage. No Kaspa L1 inject here.

wallets.name: MathWallet
wallets.note: Multi-chain Web3. Kaspa since 24 Dec 2024. Extension is not treated as a Kaspa L1 provider.

wallets.name: SafePal Software Wallet
wallets.note: Mobile companion to SafePal hardware. Hold/send KAS in the app.
